我们发现了一些静静漂流在[fortress_system.GetName]恒星系的十分巨大的太空建筑。尽管初步扫描显示它们已经很古老了，但是能量识别特征还是非常强烈。在主体建筑周围还能看到漂浮着的几个较小的建筑，所有这些似乎都是全副武装。

如果我们想要了解这个古代遗迹的真实面目，或许我们需要以武力突破其防御…

scope.en: Complete: entries, both project stages, puzzles and all endings.

uncertain: Whether 'same_option_group_as' fully hides the sibling projects once one starts is engine behaviour, not visible in the files; presented as exclusive.

label.zh: 两种入口（同一次胜利，取其一）
label.en: Two entry windows for the same victory

note.zh: 2101 经 on_ship_disabled 触发（攻击者令堡垒瘫痪）；2099 经 on_ship_destroyed_perp 触发（击毁堡垒舰船）。两者正文相同，2099 另为格式塔意识提供无需项目的捷径（选项 c.gesta）。
note.en: 2101 comes from on_ship_disabled; 2099 comes from on_ship_destroyed_perp. Same text; 2099 adds a no-project shortcut for Gestalt Consciousness (option c.gesta).

note.zh: 1B 声明 same_option_group_as = 1A（00_projects_leviathans.txt:191），二者只能进行其一。1A 需要运输舰，1B 需要科研船；均限时1080天。
note.en: 1B declares same_option_group_as = 1A (00_projects_leviathans.txt:191), so only one can run. 1A needs a transport, 1B a science ship; both have a 1080-day limit.

note.zh: 5B/5C/5D 均声明 same_option_group_as = 5A（00_projects_leviathans.txt:243,269,295）。5A 仅在有可达黑洞时出现，5C 仅在有暗物质（>10）时出现，5D 需军舰。
note.en: 5B/5C/5D all declare same_option_group_as = 5A (00_projects_leviathans.txt:243,269,295). 5A exists only with a reachable black hole, 5C only with more than 10 dark matter, 5D needs a warship (leviathans_events_2.txt:3313-3363).

label.en: Which part of the construction footage to review

note.zh: 只有“中段”（2154）能成功；“开头”与“结尾”会让堡垒重新启动。
note.en: Only the middle (2154) succeeds; the beginning and the end let the fortress restart.

texts.zh:
我们发现了一些静静漂流在[fortress_system.GetName]恒星系的十分巨大的太空建筑。尽管初步扫描显示它们已经很古老了，但是能量识别特征还是非常强烈。在主体建筑周围还能看到漂浮着的几个较小的建筑，所有这些似乎都是全副武装。

如果我们想要了解这个古代遗迹的真实面目，或许我们需要以武力突破其防御…
texts.en:
We have detected some kind of utterly massive space installation drifting quietly at the edge of the [fortress_system.GetName] system. Although preliminary scans show it to be very old, the structure has an intense power signature. Several smaller structures can be seen floating near the main installation, and all of them appear to be heavily armed.

If we are to learn the true nature of this ancient relic, we will likely have to overpower its defenses through force of arms...

label.zh: 堡垒全部舰船被瘫痪后
label.en: Once every fortress ship is disabled

label.zh: （备选入口）堡垒最后一艘舰船被击毁时
label.en: Alternative entry: when the last fortress ship is destroyed

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, this system's name appears here.

notes.zh: 审阅注：堡垒系统由 guardians 初始化器生成（星系标记 guardians_fortress_system）。玩家首次派舰队进入该系统时（on_entering_system_first_time，00_on_actions.txt:914）显示本提示，要求堡垒仍有未瘫痪的超大型空间站。它没有选项分支，只是警告。
notes.en: Review note: the fortress system carries the star flag guardians_fortress_system. The first time a player sends a ship in (on_entering_system_first_time, 00_on_actions.txt:914) this warning appears while an active XL station remains (leviathans_events_2.txt:3071-3103). It has no branches.

texts.zh:
随着我们击败了其周边的防御设施，我们得以进入这座古代建筑，一窥其奥秘。进入和穿越这座建筑可能会很困难，但无论是谁建造了它，必定是采用了我们难以想象的技术。情况变得更糟糕的是，这座堡垒似乎正在恢复。

部分协助解除堡垒武装的人员自愿尝试进入堡垒，同来自[Root.Capital.GetName]的后备人员一起一探究竟。目前看来，接下来通向目标的道路无疑充满挑战。
texts.en:
With the defeat of the defenses surrounding the ancient structure, we may find a way to explore its mysteries. Entering and traversing it may be difficult, but whoever built it must have possessed technology we can hardly dream of. Making matters more arduous, the fortress appears to be recovering.

Some of the people who helped disarm the fortress have volunteered to attempt entering and exploring it, with backup from the headquarters on [Root.Capital.GetName]. Following through on our end will no doubt present its own challenges.

label.en: Better stay out of that thing.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

notes.zh: 审阅注：选项 c「神秘破碎」需要 can_harvest_parts，不通向事件，直接获得 tech_leviathan_techgenesis 研究选项并标记 harvested_fortress_parts。
notes.en: Review note: option c needs can_harvest_parts; it leads to no event and grants the tech_leviathan_techgenesis research option plus flag harvested_fortress_parts (leviathans_events_2.txt:3059-3066).

texts.zh: 强行关闭了远古堡垒的防御系统后，我们派出了一支探索队，进去寻找阻止它重新启动的方法。
texts.en: Having forced a shutdown of the ancient fortress, a team of explorers has been sent to find a way of stopping it from powering back up.

texts.zh:
尽管我们与建造者之间存在巨大的技术代沟，但有一样发明却是永垂不朽的：一扇锁死的门。在尝试强行关停堡垒后，我们发现所有的入口都被封死了。

被分调出用以调查堡垒的小队发现一个气闸，如果它还能正常运转，似乎就可以从外界打开通向其内的道路。
texts.en:
Despite the ages of technology separating us and the builders of the fortress, one invention is timeless: a closed door. After having forced the fortress to shut down, we found all entrances sealed.

The team dispatched to explore the fortress have found an airlock which at least appears possible to open from the outside, if it had been in working order.

label.zh: 我们会派人前去增援探索小队。
label.en: We'll find someone to assist the team.

tooltips.zh: 发起特殊项目：爆破小队和局部能源供应
tooltips.en: Issues Special Projects: Demolitions Team and Local Power Surge

texts.zh: 派一支拆除专家小组登陆堡垒的侧面尝试炸开气闸。
texts.en: Send a squad of demolition experts to land on the side of the fortress and attempt to blast the airlock open.

texts.zh: 爆破小队依照计划炸开了气闸，来给我们的探查小队打开一条通道。然而爆炸并不只是点燃了气闸，由于未知的原因，也许是有意留下的陷阱，气闸内含的高气压的爆炸性气体混合着氧气混合，引发了一场更大的爆炸，我们的排险小队试图解决，但无一生还。
texts.en: The detonation set to blow the airlock open went off as planned, providing an entrance for our team of explorers. However, the explosives were not the only thing to ignite. For reasons unknown, possibly as a deliberate trap, the airlock contained pressurized explosive gas in addition to the expected oxygen, causing a larger explosion that wiped out the demolitions team sent to set it up.

label.zh: 我们只能希望他们的牺牲是值得的。
label.en: We can only hope to make their sacrifice worth it.

texts.zh:
外遣小队发现前面的道路被巨大的舱壁挡住了。小队报告说他们右方有一处嵌入墙壁的凹室，里面放着一个基座和置于其上的奇怪的机械装置，以和堡垒同样的金属材质铸造而成。

他们相信，这个装置就是打开舱壁的钥匙。小队长将这个装置描述为在基座顶部等距排列的三个立杆，有三个环——金属圆环——大小不一，放置在左边的立杆上，最小的在顶部，而最大的在最下面。
texts.en:
The away team find their way blocked by a massive bulkhead. The team report that there is a recessed alcove to their right, housing a pedestal and a contraption wrought in the same black metal as the fortress itself.

They believe this device is the key to opening the bulkhead. The leader of the explorers describes it as three upright poles spaced equidistant across the top of the pedestal, with three rings - metal tori - of varying sizes placed around the leftmost pole, the smallest at the top and the largest at the bottom.

label.zh: 把金属环放在另外两个立杆上。
label.en: Place metal rings around the remaining two poles.

label.zh: 寻找舱壁上的圆环形缺口。
label.en: Search for torus-shaped indentations on the bulkhead.

label.zh: 重排立杆上的金属圆环。
label.en: Rearrange the metal tori on the poles.

label.zh: 拆掉基座上中间和右边的竖杆。
label.en: Remove center and rightmost poles from the pedestal.

notes.zh: 审阅注：四个选项中仅“重新排列金属环”（c）通向 2133 并继续；其余三项全部通向 2132（堡垒重启，事件链结束）。选项本身没有条件。
notes.en: Review note: of the four options only 'Rearrange the metal tori' (c) leads on to 2133; the other three all lead to 2132 (fortress restarts, chain ends). The options have no conditions (leviathans_events_2.txt:3240-3255).

texts.zh:
行动指令发布后，随之而来的是一阵寂静，随着小队试图执行命令，又传来了模糊不清的刮擦噪音。又是一阵寂静后，模糊不清的曳步声和越来越尖锐的声音持续了五秒。接着是一阵长长的寂静。我们花了几分钟才确定，这次探索已经结束。没有尖叫声，也没有人呼救。我们至少可以希冀，这意味着他们没有承受太多痛苦。

一刻钟后，一阵缓慢而沉重的敲击声暗示着，无论是何种陷阱被激活，现在其已被重置。一些在场者声称，这听起来就像是异星人的笑声。

最后，堡垒中响起了更加令人不安的声音：堡垒的能源重启了防御系统。
texts.en:
After the course of action was announced, a moment of silence followed, then vague scraping noises as the team attempted to carry out their plan. After another pause, faint shuffling and a draw-out, sharp sound increasing in pitch over five seconds. Then a long silence. It took us several minutes to accept that this was the end of the expedition. No screaming, no calls for aid. We can at least hope this means they met a quick end.

After a quarter, a slow, heavy rasp suggests whatever trap sprung on them reset itself. Some present claim it sounded like alien laughter.

Finally, the fortress managed an even more disturbing sound: that of the power returning to its defense systems.

label.zh: 这鬼地方就是个可怕的机关。
label.en: This place is a hellish contraption.

texts.zh:
行动方案宣布后，先是出现了片刻的寂静，随后正当队伍尝试执行计划时，出现了隐隐约约的刮擦声。然后响起了巨大的拍击声。一时间，你还以为你的队伍像虫子一样被拍死了。紧接着，你听到了探索队的欢呼，他们兴奋地报告说通道打开了。

隔板迅速化成了紫色水银般的难闻液体。想起之前那个无聊的解谜机关，你不禁觉得你的探索队被数千年前精心设下的一个玩笑给耍了。
texts.en:
After the course of action was announced, a moment of silence followed, then vague scraping noises as the team attempted to carry out their plan. A splashing sound, so loud that at first you think the team has been swatted like small insects, is followed by cheers from the team as they report that a passage has opened.

The bulkhead appears to have rapidly transformed into an unpleasant-smelling liquid reminiscent of purple quicksilver. Combined with the relatively mundane puzzle mechanism, you have a feeling the team has been victims of an elaborate prank set up millennia ago.

label.zh: 至少我们可以开怀大笑了。
label.en: We can laugh about it now, at least.

tooltips.zh: 外遣小队的探索将继续下去……

texts.zh:
探索队发来报告，称他们似乎进入了堡垒的几何中心。只不过堡垒的内部结构还存有一些疑点，而且也不能确切地说中心这个概念适用于这里。

但有一点是毫无争议的，那就是堡垒的能源供给方式，这使得探索队的新发现更加耐人寻味了。暗物质在堡垒周围流动，然后回到核心，这有点类似血液循环系统。虽然流动已经停止了，但小队发现有重新启动的迹象。我们确实可以花费大把的时间研究这套系统，但眼下我们得赶紧将它关闭。
texts.en:
The team reports that they have reached what appears to be the geometric center of the fortress, even if the internal geometry leaves some doubt if the concept of a center is even relevant in there.

What is indisputably relevant is how the fortress is powered, which makes the team's new discovery all the more interesting. Dark matter is funneled around the fortress and then back to the core, like a cardiovascular system. Although the flow has stopped, the team has found signs that it's starting again. We can take all the time we want to study it, but it needs to be stopped now.

texts.zh: 研究附近的恒星也许能够让我们找到一些关于这座堡垒建造过程的线索。
texts.en: Studying the local star might give some insight into the conditions the builders of the fortress started their work in.

texts.zh:
我们在附近一带的恒星中搜寻堡垒是如何建成的线索时，无意中发现一个秘密。该恒星附近有一簇纳米摄像头，担当着堡垒的眼睛，这就难怪它的防御能力那么高效了。

只要将这些摄像头中的数据记录跟堡垒中的线索连接起来，我们应该就能查看这个堡垒被建造之初的相关历史。但因为时间无多，我们该优先查看哪一部分的建造过程呢？
texts.en:
Scouring the local star for clues to how the fortress was built, we discovered a surprising secret. A fine mist of nanotechnological cameras have been found in close proximity to the star, acting as the eyes of the fortress and explaining the efficiency of its defenses.

Accessing these with data from the fortress, we can view the history of the system all the way back to its construction. However, we are running out of time. Which part of the construction process should we review for answers?

texts.zh: 我们查看了堡垒建造之初时的录像以期看到堡垒心脏部分的建造过程，可惜结果让人很失望。最初建造的是堡垒的躯壳，然而这些数据对我们毫无意义。这时候堡垒开始了重启，摄像头和录像的使用权也被其重夺回去了。
texts.en: Hoping to see the heart of the fortress built first, we reviewed the beginning of the construction. We hoped in vain. The hull was built first, making the data useless. Our team are reporting that the fortress is repowering, and with it its control of the cameras and their footage.

texts.zh:
镜头的中段，虽然没有展示核心自身的建设，但却揭示了科学家们认为用于建造核心的材料的运输。这一定是结构需要动力来继续建设的关键时刻。

有了这些材料的知识，堡垒内团队设法阻止了堡垒的重启。我们可以收获成功的果实了。
texts.en:
The middle section of the footage, although not showing the construction of the core itself, reveals the shipping of materials to the fortress which scientists conclude must have been used for the core. This must have been the critical time at which the structure needed power for construction to continue.

With knowledge of these materials, the team inside the fortress has managed to stop it from repowering. We can now reap the fruits of our success.

texts.zh: 查看建造过程的最终部分时，我们才发现原来这部分是需要堡垒启动后才可以观看的。我们开始观看的时候一定是触发了核心的重新启动。我们的团队汇报堡垒正在重新启动，摄像头和录像的使用权也被夺回了。
texts.en: Reviewing the final stages of the construction, we discovered too late that they must have required the fortress to already be powered. The core must have been functional at the point where we started our viewing. Our team are reporting that the fortress is repowering, and with it its control of the cameras and their footage.

texts.zh: 如果能够将我们自己拥有的暗物质提供给堡垒的核心，也许能够让堡垒系统误以为自己已经在运行，从而停止输送。
texts.en: If we provide our own supply of dark matter to the heart of the fortress, we might be able to trick the system that it is already running and stop the flow.

texts.zh:
完成堡垒的人一定比我们更博学，但他们并不更聪明。我们向堡垒动力系统循环注入自己的暗物质的努力是有用的，有效地切断了核心对其系统的供能。

我们终于有时间仔细看看这些博学的人完成了什么东西。
texts.en:
Whoever built the fortress might have been more knowledgeable than we, but not more clever. Supplying our own dark matter to close the loop of the power system in the fortress worked, and the core is now effectively cut off from providing power to its systems.

Finally, we can take the time to have a closer look at what these knowledgeable people have accomplished.

texts.zh: 我们的团队成功通过某处被遗弃的管道打开了一条通往堡垒核心的通道。对着核心发射一枚鱼雷也许可以阻止它重启。
texts.en: Our team has managed to open up a passage to the core through an empty duct. Firing a torpedo into the core might stop it from restarting.

texts.zh:
一位飞行员以前所未有的勇气和精准度，向堡垒的心脏发射了一枚鱼雷，终止了它的重启。我们的计划必然被誉为伟大的成功，因为堡垒永远不会再启动了。

鱼雷命中的时刻，整个结构都爆炸了，系统中的古代技术痕迹和所有恒星系中的一切物体都被摧毁。考古学家称之为“[Root.GetAdj]政府出资的最昂贵的烟花秀”。看来这一纪录短期内不会被挑战了。
texts.en:
In a feat of unprecedented bravery and precision, a pilot fired a torpedo into the heart of the fortress to stop it from repowering. The plan must be hailed as a great success, since the fortress will never be powered again.

The moment the torpedo hit, the entire structure exploded, irreversibly destroying any trace of the ancient technology in it as well as everything else in the system. Archaeologists have dubbed it "the most expensive fireworks show ever funded by the [Root.GetAdj] government." It is unlikely to be beaten anytime soon.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国的名称形容词。
note.en: In the game, your empire's adjective appears here.

label.en: By force: the system is wrecked

note.zh: 堡垒爆炸；星系内宜居行星变为核战废土，其他行星熔融，舰队尽毁；无研究奖励。
note.en: The fortress explodes; habitable planets are nuked, other rocky planets turn molten and fleets in the system are destroyed; no research reward.

texts.zh: 或许对黑洞的运作原理的研究可以帮助我们了解堡垒中的暗物质是如何被利用的。
texts.en: Perhaps the answers to how dark matter is used in the fortress can be found in the workings of a black hole.

title.en: Fortress: The Heart of Dark Matter

texts.zh:
依靠着我们所掌握关于暗物质的最新知识对黑洞进行分析后发现，这个堡垒的建造者竟然从黑洞中习得了不少关于控制物质与输送系统的科技。幸好这一切都处于精密的主系统之外，我们的探索队得以安全地改换了核心的连接线路，阻止堡垒的重新启动。

虽然这个过程已让我们的团队受益良多，但相对于整座已经敞开在我们面前的堡垒来说，那简直是小巫见大巫。
texts.en:
Examining a black hole with our new knowledge of how dark matter is used in the ancient fortress, we have discovered that its builders must have learned many of the manipulation and funneling techniques from black holes. Seeing them outside of the strict system they created allowed the team of explorers to change connections around the core safely, stopping the repowering process.

While this process alone has taught us much about the physics of black holes, it is nothing compared to the treasure that the now safely shut-down fortress presents.

label.zh: 我们一定要多加珍惜才行。

note.zh: 获得谜码编码/解码科技进度30%，+科研加成；堡垒被拆除，触发庆典情境。
note.en: Unlocks the Enigmatic Encoder/Decoder techs at 30% and a research bonus; the fortress is removed and a celebration situation starts.

texts.zh: 派出一支科研船提供局部能源，尝试将能源局限于堡垒的气闸部分。
texts.en: Send a science ship supplying energy locally, attempting to restrict power to the portion of the fortress that powers the airlock.

texts.zh: 稳定了飞船同堡垒动力系统的连接后，我们必须决定有多少能量用于第一次注入。因为堡垒使用了陌生的技术，精确的能量值难以确定。现在有两种估计方案可选。
texts.en: Having stabilized the ship's connection to the power system of the fortress, we must decide how much energy to supply in the first surge. Since the technology is unfamiliar, the exact amount is difficult to determine. Two estimates are available.

notes.zh: 审阅注：高估值（需500能量）使堡垒重启（2114，失败）；低估值（50能量）打开气闸（2115）并通向塔楼（2131）。
notes.en: Review note: the higher estimate (needs 500 energy) restarts the fortress (2114, failure); the lower one (50 energy) opens the airlock (2115) and leads to the tower (2131) (leviathans_events_2.txt:3171-3185).

texts.zh: 注入堡垒以开启大门的高水平能量足以导致堡垒内的深层能源激活。堡垒的防御系统再次启动，关闭他们之前不必再管气闸了。
texts.en: The high level of energy sent into the fortress to power the door was powerful enough to cause the reignition of a deeper energy source within. With its defenses online once again, the airlock will not be a concern until we've disabled them.

label.zh: 失败：能量过载，堡垒重启
label.en: Failure: energy surge restarts the fortress

note.zh: （花费500能量的选项）堡垒修复并恢复运作，事件链结束。
note.en: (The 500-energy option) the fortress is repaired and reactivates; chain ends.

texts.zh: 一开始，注入堡垒的能量总量似乎太少，没能起到什么作用。随后，周围区域的气闸开始慢慢显示出恢复运作的迹象。靠着一些机械学的技巧和猜测，探索小队获得了控制权并成功打开气闸。虽然对接的流程不怎么规范，他们现在确实进入了堡垒内部。
texts.en: At first, the amount of energy supplied to the fortress seemed too small to make a difference. Then, the area surrounding the airlock slowly started to show signs of functioning. With some mechanical tricks and guesswork, the team accessed the controls and managed to open the airlock itself. Although not by the cleanest docking procedure, they are now inside the fortress.

label.en: Let's hope we can also get them out.

texts.zh: 时间不够了。神秘的堡垒已从我们起初的攻击中恢复、重启防御。与勘探队的通信被干扰了，但最后的通讯表明他们面临着他们预想中的命运。
texts.en: Time has run out. The enigmatic fortress has recovered from our initial assault and is once again starting up its defenses. Transmissions from the exploration team have already been scrambled, but their last transmission indicates that they met the fate they were prepared to risk.

label.zh: 但并非是我们希望的那一种。
label.en: But not the one we hoped for.

label.zh: 失败/放弃：堡垒自行重启
label.en: Failure or abandonment: the fortress restarts

note.zh: 由两种途径到达：选择“离远点”360天后，或项目 1A/5A 超时失败。重启后事件链结束。
note.en: Reached by choosing to stay away (360 days later) or when project 1A or 5A times out. Chain ends.

texts.zh:
随着我们击败了其周边的防御设施，我们得以进入这座古代建筑，一窥其奥秘。进入和穿越这座建筑可能会很困难，但无论是谁建造了它，必定是采用了我们难以想象的技术。情况变得更糟糕的是，这座堡垒似乎正在恢复。

部分协助解除堡垒武装的人员自愿尝试进入堡垒，同来自[Root.Capital.GetName]的后备人员一起一探究竟。目前看来，接下来通向目标的道路无疑充满挑战。
texts.en:
With the defeat of the defenses surrounding the ancient structure, we may find a way to explore its mysteries. Entering and traversing it may be difficult, but whoever built it must have possessed technology we can hardly dream of. Making matters more arduous, the fortress appears to be recovering.

Some of the people who helped disarm the fortress have volunteered to attempt entering and exploring it, with backup from the headquarters on [Root.Capital.GetName]. Following through on our end will no doubt present its own challenges.

texts.zh:
瓦解它的防御之后，我们很快潜入了它的结构层中。

它迷宫般的走廊和密集的网络既令人陌生也无法理解。目前为止我们只遇到了些微不足道的困难，但这个堡垒依旧有可能对我们构成威胁。
texts.en:
Having picked apart its defenses, we soon insinuated ourself into the structure.

Its labyrinthine corridors and dense networks both prove equally alien and impenetrable. There is little for us here, but the fortress could still pose a threat.

label.en: Better stay out of that thing.

label.zh: 我们回收一切能回收的，剩下的都毁掉。
label.en: We salvage what we can and scuttle the rest.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

summary.text:
# 神秘堡垒 / The Enigmatic Fortress

- 分类 Category：巨兽与城邦 · DLC：利维坦 Leviathans

## 如何开始 How it starts
- 玩家舰队首次进入堡垒星系且仍有未瘫痪的超大型空间站时，出现提示 2105。 The first player ship entering the fortress system gets warning 2105 while an active XL station remains.
- 堡垒全部舰船被瘫痪后，on_ship_disabled → 隐藏 2100 → 窗口 2101；或最后一艘堡垒舰船被击毁时，on_ship_destroyed_perp → 窗口 2099（同样正文）。 Once all fortress ships are disabled, hidden 2100 opens window 2101; alternatively destroying the last fortress ship opens 2099 (same text).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline
1. 2101 / 2099：“那就上吧”开启事件链并进入堡垒（2111）；“离远点”360天后堡垒重启（2160）。 Go ahead starts the event chain (2111); staying away restarts the fortress after 360 days.
2. 第一阶段项目（二选一）：1A 爆破组（运输舰，成功→2112→30天后塔楼 2131）或 1B 局部电力（科研船，成功→2113：高估值500能量→2114 堡垒重启；低估值50能量→2115→塔楼 2131）。 Stage 1 (one of two): 1A demolition or 1B local power surge.
3. 塔楼谜题 2131：四个选项中只有“重新排列金属环”通向 2133 → 30天 → 2150；其余三项→2132 堡垒重启。 Tower puzzle: only one option of four continues.
4. 第二阶段项目（四选一，2150）：5A 黑洞研究（需附近黑洞与科学家）→2151；5B 母星研究→2152；5C 供应暗物质（需>10暗物质）→2156；5D 武力→2157。 Stage 2 (one of four).
5. 2152“星光见证”：开头→2153（失败）、中段→2154（成功）、结尾→2155（失败）。

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes
- 成功 Solved：2151 / 2154 / 2156，获得谜码编码/解码科技进度30%及研究加成，堡垒移除并启动庆典情境（见该故事）。
- 武力 By force：2157，恒星系宜居行星化为废土，其余岩质行星熔融，系内舰队被毁，无研究奖励。
- 失败 Failure：2114、2132、2153、2155、2160，堡垒修复重启，事件链结束；项目 1A/5A 超时（1080天）也进入 2160。
- 2101 选项 c（需 can_harvest_parts）直接获得 tech_leviathan_techgenesis 研究选项。

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants
格式塔意识：2099 的选项 c.gesta 直接给予科研加成与科技进度、清除堡垒并启动庆典，无需项目。 Gestalt Consciousness gets an immediate reward at 2099 without projects.
